independence_statement: Separation was performed at source-patch level. Patient- and WSI-level independence could not be guaranteed from the released metadata.

near_duplicate_signal_independence.shared_input: the same canonical RGB source patch
near_duplicate_signal_independence.statement: Perceptual average-hash distance and frozen ResNet-18 embedding cosine are methodologically distinct pixel-summary and learned-representation signals; they are not claimed to be statistically independent.

policy.embedding_method: cosine similarity of official frozen torchvision ResNet-18 embeddings
policy.exact_method: SHA-256 over shape, dtype, and canonical image bytes plus array equality
policy.ranking_rule: exact equality, evidence count, embedding cosine, perceptual distance, stable IDs
